scope: Current mapped project source audit, plus documented Roblox defaults. This is a control map, not a live-input test.

bindings.label: Move
bindings.context: Normal character movement; also cancels resting emotes and bench exercise. Native Roblox movement.

bindings.label: Hold for running boost
bindings.context: Requires Running level 40; also modifies emote number shortcuts while that menu is open.

bindings.label: Open Shop
bindings.context: Menu shortcut, outside typing or conflicting modal input.

bindings.label: Open Garden / pets
bindings.context: Opens the Garden management tab.

bindings.label: Open Discover
bindings.context: Opens the creature discovery tab.

bindings.label: Open Inventory
bindings.context: Both letters open the same inventory. I also has a Roblox camera-zoom default.

bindings.label: Open Trails
bindings.context: Uses the installed Trails menu shortcut.

bindings.label: Open Emotes
bindings.context: C becomes Dive while swimming. Period is the alternative menu key.

bindings.label: Perform Come emote
bindings.context: The emote controller must be enabled and no text field focused.

bindings.label: Stop following pet
bindings.context: Stops the pet following you. In admin camera modes H can instead restore hidden controls.

bindings.label: Interact / primary action
bindings.context: Nearby native prompts: collect, hatch, buy, use equipment, feed, mirrors and house items. In management, comparison and certificate screens, activates the current primary action.

bindings.label: Drop / Follow / leave gym
bindings.context: Drops a carried egg or eligible item, Follow/Stay at a pet, or stops gym use. Drop is blocked on training equipment.

bindings.label: Praise pet / eat or drink held food
bindings.context: Praise on a nearby pet; consumes held fish, banana or a drink when the food action is available. The current food binding is R.

bindings.label: Unequip held item
bindings.context: Unequips a held tool when not carrying an egg. Placement uses Q for rotation instead.

bindings.label: Rotate placed house item left / right
bindings.context: Only while positioning a house object; other ordinary UI/hotkeys are suppressed. Q turns left, E turns right.

bindings.label: Mount / dismount
bindings.context: For your eligible mountable pet, including its contextual tray action.

bindings.label: Open held Boom Box music
bindings.context: While holding your Boom Box. Placed Boom Box interactions use nearby prompts.

bindings.label: Upgrade gym equipment
bindings.context: Nearby treadmill or weights-bench upgrade prompt.

bindings.label: Jump / swim up / Turbo Boost
bindings.context: Jump on land, rise or exit at a water edge, or trigger an eligible equipped Turbo Boost 4000. Also activates selected UI controls.

bindings.label: Swim downward
bindings.context: While swimming. C passes back to Emotes outside swimming.

bindings.label: Close window / cancel placement
bindings.context: Closes the foremost game window or cancels item/trap placement.

bindings.label: Select hotbar slot
bindings.context: 1 is reserved for eggs and hides when empty. 2 to 0 select the other current-page items.

bindings.label: Choose emote 1 to 9 / 10 to 18
bindings.context: While Emotes is open, 1 to 9 select its first row; Shift plus 1 to 9 select its second row. These temporarily take priority over hotbar selection.

bindings.label: Previous / next hotbar page
bindings.context: Minus goes back; equals goes forward. These refer to physical keys, including the shifted plus label.

bindings.label: Navigate pets / menu choices
bindings.context: Arrow keys navigate Garden, Stored and Discover; adjust focused dropdowns/sliders; resize a selected window handle. Outside UI, Roblox uses up/down for movement and left/right for the camera.

bindings.label: First / last dropdown choice
bindings.context: When a shared dropdown is open. Native selected scrolling frames may also use these keys.

bindings.label: Activate selected UI choice
bindings.context: Native UI selection and shared dropdown confirmation.

bindings.label: Toggle developer tools
bindings.context: Authorised developer tools only. The custom item hotbar disables the native backpack UI.

bindings.label: Restore hidden admin camera controls
bindings.context: When the admin camera has hidden its interface.

bindings.label: Admin flight movement
bindings.context: When admin flight is active: move with WASD, Space goes up, either Ctrl goes down.

bindings.label: Admin free-camera movement
bindings.context: Free-camera mode: WASD moves, Q/left Ctrl descends, E/Space ascends.

bindings.label: Roblox menu / dismiss
bindings.context: Roblox-reserved menu key; game windows also listen for dismissal.

bindings.label: Open Roblox chat
bindings.context: Native chat shortcut when the chat feature is enabled.

bindings.label: Show / hide player list
bindings.context: Native player list shortcut.

bindings.label: Toggle UI selection mode
bindings.context: Roblox UI Navigation Toggle setting controls this shortcut.

bindings.label: Scroll selected UI
bindings.context: Native UI-selection scrolling; Home and End also have game dropdown actions.

bindings.label: Zoom camera out
bindings.context: Native camera default. I zooms in natively but has a game Inventory binding here.

bindings.label: Native tool drop / edit text
bindings.context: Roblox default tool drop. Game tools commonly disable native dropping; use the game F action for validated drops.

bindings.label: Roblox developer console
bindings.context: Roblox-reserved control, distinct from the game developer tools.

bindings.label: Toggle fullscreen on Windows
bindings.context: Roblox-reserved control. On Mac the documented function is Show desktop.

bindings.label: Record video on Windows
bindings.context: Roblox-reserved control.

bindings.label: Take screenshot
bindings.context: Roblox-reserved Print Screen control.

bindings.label: Caps lock
bindings.context: System or modifier key. No dedicated project action found.

bindings.label: Modifier
bindings.context: System or modifier key. No dedicated project action found.

bindings.label: Modifier
bindings.context: System or modifier key. No dedicated project action found.

bindings.label: OS key
bindings.context: System or modifier key. No dedicated project action found.

bindings.label: OS key
bindings.context: System or modifier key. No dedicated project action found.

bindings.label: OS menu
bindings.context: System or modifier key. No dedicated project action found.

bindings.label: Num lock
bindings.context: System or modifier key. No dedicated project action found.

bindings.label: Scroll lock
bindings.context: System or modifier key. No dedicated project action found.

bindings.label: System
bindings.context: System or modifier key. No dedicated project action found.

bindings.label: Hold to hide
bindings.context: Running level 20, on land in grass or behind cover, more than 20 studs from guardians. Move at 30% speed. Ctrl retains Dive while swimming; L2 and touch use the shared action.

notes: J, K, Y and Z have no direct project action binding in this audit.
Grey keys mean no project binding was found, not a guarantee that Roblox, the operating system, typing or keyboard firmware leaves them unused.
The diagram uses a US ANSI layout. KeyCode refers to physical key positions; printed legends can differ on other keyboard layouts.
When a text field is focused, ordinary letter shortcuts normally yield to typing. House placement suppresses unrelated shortcuts, including otherwise unassigned letters.
This map records current source, not earlier chat intentions. R currently consumes food as well as praising pets; F is the drop/follow/gym-exit family.
Numpad keys have no explicit project binding. With Num Lock off, their navigation behavior depends on the keyboard and client.
